title: Meeting notifications.
officialText:
The general contractor must notify the department at least 48 hours in advance of any
safety coordination meeting or pre-jump safety meeting. No work related to the erecting, jumping, climbing, or dismantling of
the tower or climber crane is to be performed without prior notice of the meeting having been given to the department.
